entries.label: Command palette
entries.description: Opens the command line empty, with every command you own listed as you type.

entries.label: Saved decrees
entries.description: Keep a decree under a name and enact it again later with one command.

entries.label: Compound conditions
entries.description: Join conditions in a decree with and, or and not.

entries.label: Chaining
entries.description: Let one decree react to the policy another decree chose.

entries.label: Crown correspondence
entries.description: Let decrees read what the crown still demands, as owedOre, owedWood, owedGrain and owedCoin.

entries.label: Exact books
entries.description: Shows debt to the decimal instead of rounded up to the nearest ten, and how long until announced auditors arrive. Decrees may also read debt.

entries.label: True reports
entries.description: Strips governors' exaggeration: the Ledger's rates count only what the stores really receive, and each governor is listed with their real output and the gap.
